messages:
sam_devx: customer trying to deploy our JS SDK to Deno Deploy and Bun and hitting import/crypto/type errors. can we sync on quick fixes?

anya_sdk: yep. common pattern: our package uses node: specifiers and Node globals. Deno/Bun either deny node: or don't provide process/crypto.

rohit_build: short-term workaround: prepend a tiny shim in the app that defines process.env and ensures webcrypto is available. e.g. set (globalThis as any).process = { env: { REDWOOD_KEY: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') } } before importing SDK.

mina_infra: medium-term: publish an ESM "edge" build (dist/edge.mjs) that avoids node: imports, uses webcrypto APIs, and add a package export subpath like "./edge" so consumers can import '@redwood-inference/sdk/edge'.

anya_sdk: also TS friction: Deno users hit fetch/RequestInit mismatches. add examples/deno/tsconfig.json recommending "lib": ["dom","esnext"] and include a small types-deno.d.ts as a stopgap.

rohit_build: adapter sketch: dynamic import node crypto only as fallback so bundlers don't statically pull node: specifiers into edge builds.

mina_infra: CI: add quick smoke steps to GH actions to run deno run on examples/deno and bun run on examples/bun to catch regressions.

sam_devx: action items: 1) anya to open PR adding edge build + exports, 2) rohit to add deno/bun examples + shim README, 3) mina to add CI smoke job, 4) docs short note on streaming support in edge runtimes. will share a canary when ready. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: created issue RED-4501: "SDK: Deno/Bun edge build + examples + types + CI" assigned to @anya_sdk.
